name: Non-inverting amplifier circuit
summary: Uses an amplifier feedback arrangement to amplify a signal without the intended polarity inversion.
description: Uses an amplifier feedback arrangement to amplify a signal without the intended polarity inversion.

On a schematic, identify the non-inverting input, feedback divider and reference node and trace the amplified output and feedback return. Keep the component tag and signal/reference names consistent across the control drawing, terminal schedule and device documentation.
A non-inverting configuration has a circuit-defined gain; the generic op-amp triangle does not establish it.
